_comment: Minimum system RAM in GB an algorithm needs on a CPU, excluding OS and RainbowMiner overhead. Overhead is added separately via MinFreeMemoryGB (config.txt). RandomX values are dataset + cache in fast mode, the per-thread scratchpad is negligible next to those. Only list algorithms with a large, fixed, well-known footprint - an entry that is too high silently disables a working algorithm.
